title: Compute Mössbauer fraction ratios
action: Implement the Mössbauer fraction formula for the Debye model with degenerate branches and no change in force constants (κ=0). The formula involves the sum over Matsubara frequencies n of a term containing arctan, as derived in the paper. Evaluate the fraction f at T=80 K, 295 K, and 425 K using the specified Be Debye temperature Θ=1160 K, mass ratio μ = M_Be/m_Fe - 1, and recoil energy R from the 14.4 keV gamma line. Compute the ratios f(295 K)/f(80 K) and f(425 K)/f(80 K) and write them to the output file.
description: Mössbauer fraction ratios for ⁵⁷Fe in Be at 295 K and 425 K relative to 80 K.

title: Compute temperature shifts of Mössbauer line
action: Implement the temperature shift formula (χ(ξ) expression) for the Debye model with the same material parameters (Θ=1160 K, μ = M_Be/m_Fe - 1, gamma energy 14.4 keV). Compute the shift δE between 80 K and 295 K, and between 295 K and 425 K. Convert to mm/s. Write the values to the output file.
description: Temperature shift of the Mössbauer line for ⁵⁷Fe in Be between the specified temperature intervals.
